snippet.title: CrackSword alpha 0.4.3 trailer
snippet.description:
CrackSword is a 2D sword & magic - dueling game set in a surreal fantasy world drawn with colored pencil. Free directional combat, physics-based animations, and surreal magic accompany ragdoll-like puppets fighting to break free from their master.

CrackSword is a solo dev project built on godot 4.5, 
follow updates, read devlog and download the latest executable from: 
https://salmonellasalami.itch.io/
